summary: Grayscale Avalanche Staking ETF filed an 8-K on September 29, 2026 announcing that Grayscale Investments Sponsors, LLC, as sponsor, entered a Sixth Amendment to the Master Custody Service Agreement with Anchorage Digital Bank N.A. Anchorage will custody a portion of the Trust's AVAX holdings; Coinbase Custody Trust Company remains primary custodian and its arrangement is unaffected. The sponsor retains sole discretion over allocation between custodians and has not determined the amount to transfer. No price, stake, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or closing terms are stated. This is a routine custody-services contract, not a special situation.
